# quantms Portal — Full Reference

> Data portal hosting 251 standardized proteomics datasets across 4 collections in QPX Parquet format.

## Overview

The quantms Portal provides access to reanalyzed quantitative proteomics datasets. All datasets were processed with the quantms or quantmsdiann pipelines and converted to the standardized QPX format.

## Collections

### Absolute Expression (103 datasets)
- Human proteomics datasets quantified with iBAQ
- 470,804 proteins across 18,053 samples
- Use case: protein expression reference, tissue/cell line atlases
- Browse: https://portal.quantms.org/collections/absolute-expression

### Differential Expression (35 datasets)
- Disease vs. control comparisons
- 162,915 quantified proteins
- Use case: biomarker discovery, disease proteomics
- Browse: https://portal.quantms.org/collections/differential-expression

### MS-Net (107 datasets)
- 53 species, 500M+ PSMs
- Use case: ML training data, spectral library building, cross-species proteomics
- Browse: https://portal.quantms.org/collections/msnet

### Single Cell Proteomics (6 datasets)
- 538 single-cell samples
- Use case: single-cell proteomics analysis
- Browse: https://portal.quantms.org/collections/single-cell

## Data Access

### Static JSON API
All data is available as static JSON files — no backend required.

# Registry (list all collections)
GET https://portal.quantms.org/data/registry.json

# Collection summary
GET https://portal.quantms.org/data/collections/{collection}/collection.json

# Dataset listing (paginated, 50 per page)
GET https://portal.quantms.org/data/collections/{collection}/datasets-page-1.json

# Dataset detail
GET https://portal.quantms.org/data/collections/{collection}/datasets/{accession}.json

# Portal statistics
GET https://portal.quantms.org/data/portal-stats.json

### Raw Data
Original raw files and processed QPX Parquet files are available via PRIDE FTP:
https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/pride/resources/proteomes/

## Baseline Expression Browser

Compare protein expression across human tissues and cell lines:
- URL: https://portal.quantms.org/baseline
- 15,782 proteins across 30+ human tissues
- Shareable URLs: https://portal.quantms.org/baseline?proteins=P50851,Q96HS1
- Data: iBAQ log2 intensities

## AI Models

6 ML models trained on MS-Net collection data, cataloged at:
https://portal.quantms.org/models

## Dataset Identifiers

Datasets use ProteomeXchange accessions:
- PXD prefix: PRIDE/ProteomeXchange
- IPX prefix: iProX
- MSV prefix: MassIVE

## QPX Format

All datasets are in QPX (Quantitative Proteomics Exchange) Parquet format.
Use the qpx Python package to read: pip install qpx

import qpx
df = qpx.read_parquet("dataset.parquet")

## Related Tools

- quantms: DDA pipeline that produced these datasets (https://docs.quantms.org)
- quantmsdiann: DIA pipeline (https://quantmsdiann.quantms.org)
- qpx: QPX format toolkit (https://qpx.quantms.org)
- mokume: protein quantification (https://mokume.quantms.org)

## Citation

Dai C et al. Nature Methods. 2024;21:1603-1607. DOI: 10.1038/s41592-024-02343-1
